Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 071. 按权重生成随机数

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> presum;

    Solution(vector<int>& w) {
        int n = w.size();
        presum.resize(n + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) presum[i + 1] = presum[i] + w[i];
    }

    int pickIndex() {
        int n = presum.size();
        int x = rand() % presum[n - 1] + 1;
        int left = 0, right = n - 2;
        while (left < right) {
            int mid = left + right >> 1;
            if (presum[mid + 1] >= x)
                right = mid;
            else
                left = mid + 1;
        }
        return left;
    }
};

/**
 * Your Solution object will be instantiated and called as such:
 * Solution* obj = new Solution(w);
 * int param_1 = obj->pickIndex();
 */
